page_title: JUV 2-0 ACM | Juventus v AC Milan 18/01/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' The referee blows his whistle for the final time to end this match.
90+3' The actual number of corner kicks in this match – 5:5.
90+1' We will have 4 min. of added time.
90' It's time for a substitution. That's the last involvement from Samuel Mbangula as he is replaced by Vasilije Adzic (Juventus).
89' Francesco Camarda (AC Milan) connects with a cross from the side, but produces a header which goes miles wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Juventus will have a goal kick.
88' AC Milan take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
88' AC Milan failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat. Good work from AC Milan as they win a corner.
88' Yunus Musah (AC Milan) delivers a low pass into the box which is intercepted. AC Milan have a corner.
86' Wonderful movement by AC Milan. The players are holding possession, mostly exchanging one-touch passes. They control the pace of the game now.
83' Thiago Motta prepares a substitution. Khephren Thuram is replaced by Nicolo Fagioli (Juventus).
83' Substitution. Nicolas Gonzalez will be replaced by Dusan Vlahovic (Juventus).
81' Theo Hernandez (AC Milan) swings the ball into the box from the corner kick but it's a bit too strong and it goes out of play. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Juventus.

81' AC Milan are happy to keep the ball as they wait for gaps in defence to open up. However, an opposing player steps in and clears. AC Milan force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
80' Sergio Conceicao has decided to substitute Tijjani Reijnders and he is replaced by Filippo Terracciano (AC Milan).
80' The manager makes a subsitution with Luka Jovic (AC Milan) coming on for Tammy Abraham.

79' AC Milan will look to take advantage of a free kick in a promising position in the middle of the field. Theo Hernandez (AC Milan) receives the ball from the resulting free kick and unleashes a strike from the edge of the box, but his effort goes narrowly wide of the right post! The ball goes out of play and Juventus will have a goal kick.
77' Tijjani Reijnders (AC Milan) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being well blocked by one of the defenders.
76' Yunus Musah (AC Milan) releases a low pass from just outside the box in an attempt to find his teammate, but one of the defenders calmly averts the threat.
75' Thiago Motta decides to make a substitution. Teun Koopmeiners will be replaced by Douglas Luiz (Juventus).
74' Substitution. Emerson Royal makes his way off the pitch and Francesco Camarda (AC Milan) comes on as his replacement.
72' The free kick into the penalty area from Teun Koopmeiners (Juventus) is cleared.
72' Davide Massa shows a yellow card to Emerson Royal (AC Milan) for a tough tackle.
69' Teun Koopmeiners (Juventus) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates.
69' The corner is swung in but Juventus can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Juventus.
68' Timothy Weah (Juventus) sends a sweet pass into the penalty area, but one of the defenders averts the danger. The ball is out of play. Juventus will have a chance to score from a corner.
67' Teun Koopmeiners (Juventus) swings in the corner kick, but one of the defenders leaps highest to head the ball away.
66' Juventus are happy to keep the ball as they wait for gaps in defence to open up. However, an opposing player steps in and clears. Juventus have been awarded a corner kick.

64' 2 - 0 Timothy Weah (Juventus) finishes his beautiful individual effort with a superb strike from inside the box. Mike Maignan is just a bystander as the ball flies low into the middle of the goal. The score is 2:0.
63' Substitution. Ismael Bennacer makes way for Alejandro Jimenez (AC Milan).
61' A yellow card for a tackle by Ismael Bennacer (AC Milan). Davide Massa doesn't hesitate at all to make this decision.
59' Samuel Mbangula (Juventus) collects a sweet pass and scores with aplomb. His shot glanced off the crossbar and into the roof of the net. Fabulous goal!
58' Davide Massa blows his whistle after Teun Koopmeiners (Juventus) brings one of his opponents down with a strong tackle. AC Milan continue the game with a quickly taken free kick.
56' Samuel Mbangula (Juventus) attempts to find one of his teammates inside the box with a chip pass, but one of the defending players reacts superbly and intercepts the ball.

55' Teun Koopmeiners (Juventus) receives a deflected pass on the edge of the box and smashes the ball at goal. Unfortunately for him, it's well wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for AC Milan.
54' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Juventus.

53' Timothy Weah (Juventus) came close to scoring but should have done much better. His poor attempt from close range ended up in the gloves of Mike Maignan. Teun Koopmeiners (Juventus) picks up the rebound inside the penalty area and releases a good shot to the middle of the goal. Unfortunately for him, Mike Maignan shows how quick his reflexes are and dives superbly to stop his effort. What a save but what a wasted opportunity! Juventus will take a corner kick.
52' The game is interrupted, a clear handball by Weston McKennie (Juventus). It's a free kick to AC Milan in a dangerous position.

50' Juventus slow the tempo of the game down by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult at the moment, very physically demanding to run without the ball.
48' The current number of shots on target for both teams is 7:7. The current number of shots on goal is 1:3.
46' The game is over for Kenan Yildiz (Juventus). Timothy Weah comes on for the second half.
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+2' Davide Massa blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.
45+1' Theo Hernandez (AC Milan) meets a cross inside the box, but his header is blocked by an opposing player.
45+1' Theo Hernandez (AC Milan) takes the corner kick and sends a lovely ball into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and knocks the ball to safety.
45+1' The fourth official shows 1 min. of added time.

45' Emerson Royal (AC Milan) attempts to find some of his teammates with a dangerous pass from the edge of the box. The opponent's defence, however, intercepts the effort and clears the ball to safety. It will be a corner kick for AC Milan.

43' He should have done better. Nicolas Gonzalez (Juventus) is afforded space to connect with a Samuel Mbangula cross, but his header from the centre of the box flies well wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and AC Milan will have a goal kick.

41' Juventus exchange some quick one-two passes over a small area and control the game. Now they make a mistake and lose the ball and the whole situation changes in the blink of an eye. The ball goes out of play and AC Milan will have a goal kick.
39' Kenan Yildiz (Juventus) whips a promising cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball. The ball has crossed the sideline. Juventus are taking a throw-in.
38' Khephren Thuram (Juventus) rushes a shot from long range and subsequently sends it high over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for AC Milan.
37' Teun Koopmeiners (Juventus) launches an inaccurate corner kick into the penalty area. The ball goes out of play and AC Milan will have a goal kick.

36' Mike Maignan pulls off a great save to deny Kenan Yildiz (Juventus), who makes himself some space inside the box and unleashes a quick shot towards the middle of the goal. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Juventus will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
34' Teun Koopmeiners (Juventus) sends a pass into the box, but the opposition's defence is alert to the danger and makes a clearance.
33' Juventus seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. Great movement by the offensive players allows the defenders to set up the attack.
31' Manuel Locatelli (Juventus) produces a lovely ball into the penalty area but the defender manages to intercept and comfortably averts the danger.
28' A great run by Nicolas Gonzalez (Juventus) gets him into the box, but his powerful shot is bravely blocked by a defender.

27' Rafael Leao (AC Milan) makes a yard for himself as he picks up the rebound after chaos in the box and quickly drills a low shot towards the middle of the goal. The goalkeeper pulls off a comfortable save to keep the ball from hitting the net.
24' Juventus are showing great team chemistry. They are passing it around beautifully. Excellent team work.

21' Referee Davide Massa sees the trip by Emerson Royal (AC Milan) and doesn't hesitate to blow his whistle. Teun Koopmeiners (Juventus) crosses the ball from the free kick, but it goes out of play. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for AC Milan.
19' Tijjani Reijnders (AC Milan) gets to the ball from the resulting corner and tries his luck with a shot, but one of the defenders steps in to block the effort.
19' Theo Hernandez (AC Milan) will try to find the head of one of his teammates from a corner kick.

18' AC Milan show off their ball retention skills as they exchange one-two passes and the move is only interrupted when the final pass is intercepted. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to AC Milan.
16' Davide Massa blows the whistle, Teun Koopmeiners (Juventus) is penalised for a foul. A free kick has been awarded to AC Milan.
14' Teun Koopmeiners (Juventus) has a sight of goal and shoots from long range but his ambitious effort flies just over the bar. The ball goes out of play and AC Milan will have a goal kick.
13' Davide Massa blows his whistle and it's Weston McKennie (Juventus) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee. AC Milan produce a short pass from the free kick.
11' Rafael Leao (AC Milan) collects a pass inside the box and unleashes a shot which is brilliantly blocked by a defender.
10' Davide Massa blows his whistle after Teun Koopmeiners (Juventus) kicks an opponent's legs instead of the ball. AC Milan take a quick free kick and immediately restart play.

8' Samuel Mbangula (Juventus) receives a precise pass on the edge of the box and has an effort on goal. Unfortunately for him, his strike flies inches high over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for AC Milan.
6' Tijjani Reijnders (AC Milan) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Michele Di Gregorio, who smothers the ball.
5' Samuel Mbangula (Juventus) dinks a cross into the box in an attempt to find one of his teammates, but the defence manages to clear.

4' Long passes, short passes and one-two passes. Juventus are showcasing great team work by keeping possession and producing pin-point passes from player to player. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult to intercept at the moment.
2' Samuel Mbangula (Juventus) swings in a cross, but the ball is cleared to safety by one of the defending players.
1' The match has just started.
Juventus will kick-off.
Davide Massa is introduced as the referee for today's match.
